parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The metric name. Valid values:

*   Availability
*   ErrorRate
*   ResponseTime

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Unit: milliseconds. The default value is 1 hour ahead of the current time.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the site monitoring task.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a site monitoring task, see [DescribeSiteMonitorList](~~115052~~).

parameters.name: TimeRange
parameters.description:
The statistical period.

Unit: minutes. Default value: 1440 (one day). Maximum value: 43200 (30 days).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-site-monitor-statistics --task-id ef4cdc8b-9dc7-43e7-810e-f950e56c0000 --time-range 1440 --start-time 1576142850527 --metric-name Availability --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
